  role subject "I"

  role object "me"
  role source "Filiasi"
  role destination "Craiova"

  end

  end

repaired_parse.question: Am un call cu clientul din Hamburg mâine la 10 și trebuie să știu dacă factura de servicii de consultanță se emite cu taxare inversă sau cu TVA 21%. Clientul are cod VIES valid.

@s1 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the client"
  role object "a valid VIES code"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

  where match
    relation "be issued with"
    role subject "the invoice for consulting services"
    role instrument ?v
    polarity affirmed
  end

    ?v equal "21% VAT"
  end

    role subject "the billing service"
    polarity negated
  end
